contributions.anchor: Box B 'Contributions Received this Period' = 37788.68 on the p5 SUMMARY PAGE, which is also the printed 'Sum' at the foot of the filer's own DONATIONS ledger (PDF p3) — the two figures agree to the cent
contributions.detail: CASH SIDE: the 21 rows of the DONATIONS ledger sum to 15000+1000+26.25+150+26.25+25+25+51.99+26.25+150+100+257.94+300+50+5000+500+1000+8000+5000+1000+100 = 37,788.68 exactly = the ledger's own printed 'Sum' = Box B. Box C 'Contributions Received Year to Date' prints 50796.62 and is CUMULATIVE — never summed as an increment. The cover ladder corroborates independently: A 2032.23 + B 37788.68 = F 39820.91 as printed, and F - D = 39820.91 - 37723.62 = 2097.29 = the printed close box. ⚠ THE SUM CHECKREC REPORTS FOR THIS SIDE IS 47,788.68, NOT 37,788.68, because the record also publishes the TWO IN-KIND ROWS the filer disclosed on a separate sheet (PDF p4, 'INKIND', Creative Signs 5000 + Lynn Applenaup 5000 = 10,000.00, no printed total on that sheet). Those rows are published ALONGSIDE the cash gate, never in place of it — the Ainge/Paxman Phase-A precedent — and they are demonstrably OUTSIDE Box B: monetary-plus-in-kind gives 47,788.68 and fails, monetary-only gives 37,788.68 and closes. LOAN CLASSIFICATION BY THE LADDER, not by the word (ADDENDUM B3): row 1 reads 'Brandon Gordon - Loan' 15,000 and IS an itemized contribution row here, because it is inside the ledger's own Sum which equals Box B, and Box A (2,032.23) is a separate, much smaller beginning balance with no room for it.

expenditures.anchor: Box D 'Expenditures Made this Period' = 37723.62 on the p5 SUMMARY PAGE, which is also the printed 'Sum' at the foot of the filer's own EXPENDITURES ledger (PDF p2) — the two figures agree to the cent
expenditures.detail: The 24 rows of the EXPENDITURES ledger sum to 325.79+305.2+550.45+305.2+50+100+25+2879.73+377.37+63.17+23.04+15757.46+3702.68+7000+58.53+138.77+153.08+146.91+3019.3+239.43+500+433+950+619.51 = 37,723.62 exactly = the ledger's own printed 'Sum' = Box D. Box E 'Expenditures Made Year to Date' prints 48699.33 and is CUMULATIVE, never summed. The 'Sum' line is a PRINTED TOTAL, not a 24th-and-a-half entry: it sits 6.9 percentage points below the last row after a clear blank gap, the band between them was control-cropped EMPTY, and its value equals the sum of the rows above it (ADDENDUM H4). No in-kind entry appears on the expenditure side.

itemized.in_kind_convention: MONETARY-ONLY (cash-only) — tested both ways on both sides and this is the one that closes. The filer keeps in-kind on a THIRD, separate typed sheet ('INKIND', PDF p4) carrying two 5,000 gifts and NO total, and neither stated box includes them: contributions close at 37,788.68 cash-only and fail at 47,788.68 with in-kind; expenditures close at 37,723.62 with no in-kind entry at all. ⚠ This is the OPPOSITE of the other multi-row filing in this chunk (Bill Lee b3396f89, where five in-kind gifts are INSIDE both stated totals) — the ADDENDUM G1 rule that in-kind treatment is per FILING, demonstrated twice in one chunk in both directions. The two in-kind rows are published with in_kind=true alongside the cash gate.
itemized.escalation_note: This filing carries NO county schedule grid at all on its itemized pages — rowbands.py returns ZERO printed rules on PDF pp2/3/4 — so the geometry was measured by an INK-PROJECTION of the amount column on the 200 dpi render (per-page column x-extent, then per-line dark-pixel runs), and every band was then crop-proved. 1200 dpi proof/control crops: p2 first row rendered '325.79', p2 last row rendered '619.51', the band past the last row rendered EMPTY, and the printed total line rendered '37723.62'; p3 first row rendered '15000', p3 last row rendered '100', the band past the last row rendered EMPTY; p4 rows rendered '5000' and '5000' with the band below EMPTY. No amount on this filing is ambiguous — every figure is machine type from the filer's own spreadsheet — so no cell needed a legibility escalation.

itemized.notes: THE COUNTY'S SCHEDULE A AND SCHEDULE B SHEETS ARE ABSENT AND THE FILER SUBSTITUTED THREE OF HIS OWN TYPED PORTRAIT LEDGERS — the ADDENDUM E5 case. The 6-page document is: p1 COVER (county v. 4.20 blank), p2 the filer's 'EXPENDITURES' ledger, p3 his 'DONATIONS' ledger, p4 his 'INKIND' ledger, p5 the county SUMMARY PAGE, p6 a wholly blank trailing sheet (0 rules, 0 bars, skew -2.0 — a scan artifact; pdfinfo reports 6 pages and all are accounted for).
